title: A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers
grouping: Panel (a) is a full-width row: multivariate input → 'Channel-independence' → five separate univariate series → a tall grey 'Transformer Backbone' bar shared by all → five output series → 'Concatenate' → multivariate output. Below it, two vertical stacks for the supervised and self-supervised variants sit at the left and right, with a zoomed Transformer block in a grey rounded box between them tied to the left stack's encoder by orange dashed lines.
shapes_depth: Series are drawn as real curves in thin-framed horizontal strips: green for inputs, blue for outputs. Process steps are bold purple words above hollow block arrows. The stacks are wide flat rectangles with coloured outlines and fills: yellow for norm/patching and embedding, orange for the encoder, green for the head; input and output are pale blue label bands. Patches are a row of separate pale blue vertical bars; in the self-supervised stack some bars are empty dashed outlines (masked) and the outputs are grey bars 'Reconstructed Masked Patches'. A dotted vertical axis at the far left lists each layer's tensor shape (x ∈ R^{1×L}, x_p ∈ R^{P×N}, …).
proposed_highlight: Channel independence is the emphasised idea: one shared backbone bar fed by five separate green series strips. Patching is made visible as discrete bars between layers rather than a label.
lesson: Draw patches as a row of separated vertical bars between the patching and embedding layers, show masking by turning some of them into empty dashed outlines, and track each layer's tensor shape on a left-margin axis.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF header (ICLR 2023). Composite: (a) overview plus (b)/(c) model stacks and a zoomed Transformer block. Annotation note (2026-11-15): crop appears cut at the bottom: the (b)/(c) sub-captions of the two stacks are not visible

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: A full-width overview row captioned '(a) PatchTST Model Overview' sits on top; below, two vertical layer stacks (supervised left, self-supervised right) flank a zoomed Transformer block in a grey rounded box tied to the left stack's encoder by orange dashed lines.
insights.data: Series are real curves in thin-framed horizontal strips, green for inputs and blue for outputs; layers are wide flat coloured rectangles (yellow norm/patching and embedding, orange encoder, green head); patches are a row of separated pale-blue vertical bars, masked ones drawn as empty dashed outlines, reconstructions as grey bars.
insights.emphasis: Channel independence is shown by five separate green strips feeding one shared grey 'Transformer Backbone' bar; masking is made visible by dashed empty patches only in the right stack.
insights.flow: Top row reads left to right with hollow block arrows labelled in bold purple ('Channel-independence', 'Concatenate'); the stacks read bottom to top, with a dotted vertical axis at far left listing each layer's tensor shape.
insights.avoid: The left-margin shape axis aligns only with the left stack, and the bottom stacks carry no titles in the crop, so supervised vs self-supervised must be inferred from the head.

arrangement.units: top: one full-width unframed overview row with a caption; bottom: two unframed vertical layer stacks side by side with a grey rounded zoom box between
arrangement.inputs_as: multivariate series drawn as curve strips (top); a pale 'Input Univariate Series' band at the bottom of each stack
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; reconstructed masked patches as grey bars atop the right stack
arrangement.shared: the zoomed Transformer block between the two stacks
